title.en: sunrise over the lake at woodbine beach.
title.de: sonnenaufgang über dem see am woodbine beach.

line.en: sunrise is at 07:22 on monday and sunset at 16:45. a short early walk on the beach before the day starts; bring a warm layer.
line.de: der sonnenaufgang ist am montag um 07:22, der sonnenuntergang um 16:45. ein kurzer früher spaziergang am strand, bevor der tag beginnt; warme schicht mitnehmen.
line.tr: pazartesi gündoğumu 07:22, gün batımı 16:45. gün başlamadan kısa, erken bir sahil yürüyüşü; sıcak bir katman al.

sparks.why: Sunrise 07:22 and sunset 16:45 on Mon 23 Nov 2026 (sunrise-sunset.net Toronto table); the walk is a suggestion, no event found.
